name: @nb/desktop
description: PDF markup and takeoff for construction drawings

scripts.package: pnpm --filter @nb/web build && tsc -p . && node scripts/fetch-assistant-node.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --filter @nb/web build && tsc -p . && node scripts/fetch-assistant-node.mjs --arch=arm64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/fetch-assistant-node.mjs --arch=x64 && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm --filter @nb/web build && tsc -p . && node scripts/fetch-assistant-node.mjs --arch=x64 && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
